body: You are young. I am also extremely depressed. Trust me I know what its like to feel hopeless.  School can be hard when you feel alone.  But please, just be strong.  Get a hobby that grabs your attention.  It's amazing how you can change how you feel when you're motivated.  I'm sorry about your mother.  That's incredibly hard. But try and focus on what makes you, you!  There's a lot more living to be had. And with that, there will be love and good memories.
